question: How is the second eight-petaled lotus characterized in meditation?
premises: It is illuminated by meditation on fire or radiance
inference: The second eight-petaled lotus is well illuminated through meditation on fiery radiance.
uncertainties: teja-dhyāna may refer to meditation on fire or on brilliance
